svg.text: Each card asks the harder follow-up: after the old 40-step scouting pass, which tiles still need at least 40 Newton steps, or still miss even the 80-step cutoff?

text.tspan: The old late tail was mostly scouting-budget fog; the center cools away at the harder cutoff.
Part of the old halo cools away, but a real slower core still survives.
The hard center survives almost intact even after the budget doubles.
The hard center survives almost intact even after the budget doubles.

Orange intensity = local late-tail share. Left maps keep the old scouting read (≥ 20 steps or unresolved by 40); right maps ask what still survives at the harder read (≥ 40 steps or unresolved by 80).
Dashed circle marks the unit circle; dashed crosshairs mark the origin.
